#!/bin/sh
set -eu
if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'direct archive "Unknown" "Electronic raw archive printer"'
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$#" -lt 5 ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: invalid CUPS backend invocation' >&2
  exit 1
fi
job_id=$1
title=$3
dest=/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed
state=/var/lib/cups/archive-state
marker=$state/job-$job_id
[ -f "$marker" ] && exit 0
safe=$(printf '%s' "$title" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_' | cut -c1-120)
[ -n "$safe" ] || safe=job-$job_id
case "$safe" in
  *.prn) name=$safe ;;
  *) name=$safe.prn ;;
esac
target=$dest/$name
if [ -e "$target" ]; then
  case "$name" in
    *.prn) target=$dest/${name%.prn}-cups-$job_id.prn ;;
    *) target=$dest/${name}-cups-$job_id ;;
  esac
fi
tmp=$(mktemp "$dest/.archive-$job_id.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
if [ "$#" -ge 6 ]; then
  cat -- "$6" > "$tmp"
else
  cat > "$tmp"
fi
chmod 0640 "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$target"
printf '%s\n' "$target" > "$marker.tmp"
mv -f "$marker.tmp" "$marker"
trap - EXIT
exit 0
ARCHIVE_BACKEND
sudo chown root:root /usr/lib/cups/backend/archive
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/lib/cups/backend/archive
sudo systemctl enable --now cups
sudo lpadmin -p archive -E -v archive:/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed -m raw
sudo cupsenable archive
